text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"multi-paragraph argument with introduction, body, and conclusion","quality":"organization","description":"The essay shows clearer overall structure and logical grouping of ideas across paragraphs."},{"evidence":"topic sentence plus supporting examples in each body paragraph","quality":"development","description":"The essay expands claims with explanations and examples rather than brief personal anecdotes alone."},{"evidence":"“It is a good to be a part... because it makes teachers..., it helps students..., and...”","quality":"sentence control","description":"The essay uses more controlled complex sentences and fewer run-on or awkward constructions."},{"evidence":"“teachers main job,” “students favorite,” “dont,” “proffered”","quality":"grammar control","description":"The essay generally shows fewer severe agreement and sentence-formation errors that interfere with meaning."},{"evidence":"“The people who volunteer... would also be helping their community”","quality":"academic register","description":"The essay sustains a more school-appropriate expository tone with less conversational phrasing."},{"evidence":"“The club would give students extra time... one-on-one class with a teacher”","quality":"idea elaboration","description":"The essay more fully explains how and why its points work, giving the reader more detail to follow."}]}
